result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a complete lack of dedicated walkways or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles on a surface with visible pavement degradation and limited lighting in a wooded area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks or paved shoulders forces pedestrians to walk directly in the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway throughout the frame.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and degraded asphalt creates trip hazards and uneven surfaces for anyone walking on the road edge.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and trees along the roadside may obscure sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially near curves.
